title: Multidimensional and longitudinal immune profiling of sepsis in Uganda
description: We conducted a prospective, observational cohort study of adults with severe, undifferentiated infection (i.e., suspected sepsis) admitted to two public hospitals in Uganda: Tororo General Hospital (RESERVE-U-2-TOR) and Entebbe Regional Referral Hospital (RESERVE-U-2-EBB). At both sites, whole-blood samples were collected in PAXgene Blood RNA tubes (PreAnalytiX/Qiagen, Germantown, MD, USA), and RNA was extracted using the PAXgene Blood RNA Kit (cat. no. 762164; Qiagen). Sequencing libraries were constructed using the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Preparation Kit for Illumina, multiplexed, and sequenced on the Illumina NovaSeq X Plus platform (Illumina, Inc., San Diego, CA, USA).
